summary: Frontend-only testing of the new TonAer Insights blog (/resources/blog) and article detail pages. Ran 5 Playwright suites on the public preview URL covering: listing structure (hero/featured/topics/search/chips/grid/load-more/most-read/newsletter/CTA), all 10 category filters + empty state + clear, search (positive, negative, combined with category), topic tile behaviour (filter + smooth scroll), article detail structure & SEO/JSON-LD, share links (copy toast, LinkedIn, X hrefs), related-insights scoring, 404 slug state, nav dropdown / footer / support-page entry points, newsletter demo state (no /api request captured), and 390px mobile layout. Everything specified in the review request passed; no functional or integration defects found. Backend testing skipped per request.

design_issues.screen: Blog listing - FEATURED card meta line
issues: Meta bar is hardcoded to 'TECHNOLOGY · 8 MIN READ · SEPTEMBER 2026' (BlogPage.jsx line 133) while the badge above the title reads 'CONNECTIVITY'. Should render featured.category.toUpperCase() for consistency.

action_items: Low priority: replace hardcoded 'TECHNOLOGY' label in the featured card meta line with featured.category.toUpperCase() (BlogPage.jsx:133).

Low priority: useSEO receives a freshly-created jsonLd object each render, so the effect deps change every render and the JSON-LD <script> is removed/re-appended on each re-render. Wrap the jsonLd object in useMemo (or serialize it) in ArticlePage.jsx.

Low priority: MOST READ is selected by hardcoded ids ['a04','a06','a09'] in BlogPage.jsx; if those ids are removed/unpublished the section silently renders fewer/zero items. Consider a mostRead flag in insights.js.
critical_code_review_comments: useSEO does not restore title/description/canonical on unmount; only the JSON-LD script is cleaned up. Every route currently calling useSEO makes this harmless, but any page without the hook will inherit the previous page's tags.
insights.js is data-only and clean; filterArticles/relatedArticles are pure and correct (relatedArticles excludes self and scores category*2 + shared tags, verified in browser).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified counts: 12 non-featured published articles, 9 shown initially, Load More reveals all 12 and the button disappears. Category card counts: Wi-Fi 1, Industry 2, Network Intelligence 2, AI & Intelligence 2, Cloud & SaaS 1, IoT 1, Networking 1, Connectivity 1, Product & Engineering 1, Company 0 (no-insights state + Clear restores 9). Category testids slugify '&' to 'and' (category-ai-and-intelligence, category-cloud-and-saas). Search 'Wi-Fi 7' = 1 card; 'zzzznope' = no-insights; AI & Intelligence + 'troubleshooting' = 1. Topic tile topic-ai-automation sets AI filter and scrolls (scrollY 1014). Article page: title '<Title> | TonAer Insights', canonical with slug, og:type=article, 1 JSON-LD script with @type Article; share hrefs URL-encoded for linkedin.com/sharing and twitter.com/intent; copy-link toast works with clipboard permission granted. 404 slug shows 'Insight not found.' with working back link; document.title 'Article Not Found | TonAer Insights'. Newsletter submit clears input, shows info toast, zero /api network requests. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on listing or article, category-nav overflowX auto (scrollW 1347 vs clientW 350), featured single column, body font 16px. No console errors observed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects reproduced. The only findings are cosmetic/maintainability items listed under action_items.
